mq06-57.label: Givens
mq06-57.text: Ship: 7.2 m/s north. Ana relative to the ship: 1.4 m/s east. Find her velocity relative to the water.

mq06-57.label: Substitute
mq06-57.text:
𝑣 = √((7.2 m/s)<sup>2</sup> + (1.4 m/s)<sup>2</sup>) = 7.3 m/s
𝜃 = tan⁻¹(1.4 / 7.2) = 11° east of north

mq06-57.label: Answer
mq06-57.text: 7.3 m/s at 11° east of north (relative to the water)

sol06-57.label: Givens
sol06-57.text: Ferry: 3.8 m/s east. Martin relative to the ferry: 0.62 m/s north.

sol06-57.label: Substitute
sol06-57.text:
𝑣 = √((3.8 m/s)<sup>2</sup> + (0.62 m/s)<sup>2</sup>) = 3.9 m/s
𝜃 = tan⁻¹(0.62 / 3.8) = 9.3° north of east

sol06-57.label: Answer
sol06-57.text: 3.9 m/s at 9.3° north of east (relative to the water)
